description.value:
You've trained to lead allies through the chaos of combat. Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As an action, you focus your tactical awareness for one minute. Once per turn during that time, you can call out a command or warning to an ally within 30 feet whom you can see, provided that ally can hear and understand you; that ally adds a d4 to one attack roll or saving throw. A creature can only hold the benefit of one such die at a time. You must finish a short or long rest before using this feature again.
